title: Berry Vanilla Protein Overnight Oats
subtitle: Greek yogurt overnight oats with vanilla and mixed berries, ready straight from the fridge.
description: Oats soak overnight in milk, Greek yogurt, and vanilla, then get topped with mixed berries and a drizzle of honey. It is a lighter, fruit-forward alternative to the peanut butter version for crews who want something brighter in the morning.

steps.title: Whisk the base
steps.instruction: Whisk milk, Greek yogurt, honey, and vanilla together in a large bowl or pitcher until smooth.

steps.title: Add oats and chia
steps.instruction: Stir in rolled oats and chia seeds if using, mixing until fully coated.

steps.title: Portion and chill
steps.instruction: Divide evenly into 8 jars, seal, and refrigerate at least 6 hours or overnight until thickened.

steps.title: Top with berries
steps.instruction: Stir each jar before serving, then top with mixed berries. Add a little extra milk if the oats seem too thick.

stationWorkflow: Prep this the night before a busy shift so breakfast requires zero stove time.
Keep berries separate until serving so they don't turn the oats watery in storage.
Batch mix the base in one pitcher, then portion into jars for speed.
cleanupNotes: Rinse the mixing pitcher right away — yogurt residue dries stubborn if left overnight.
Wash jars promptly after use to avoid stuck-on oats.
leftovers: Keeps sealed in the refrigerator up to 4 days.
Add berries fresh each morning rather than storing them mixed in for the whole batch.
